_comment: Candidate facts for this profile. Start empty; fill in from your own resumes (onboarding drafts these for you). Only claims you can back up belong here.
followUpTemplate: Hi {name}, I applied for the {role} role at {company} earlier and noticed it again. I'm still very interested: {hook}. Happy to share a short work sample if useful.

whyRoleTemplates.opening: I want the {role} role at {company} because it matches work I have already done.
whyRoleTemplates.closing: I'd bring the same ownership to {company}: start from the user's problem, set a clear quality bar, and ship in small, measurable steps.
